description: Per-record verification cases: verify_record(candidate, prior, rules, state) equals the expected verdict.

cases.name: accept-request
cases.description: A User authors a Request from genesis.

cases.name: accept-capability
cases.description: A User grants a Capability after a Request.

cases.name: accept-action
cases.description: A Provider acts under an Auto capability it names via a Require ref.

cases.name: accept-result
cases.description: An Executor reports a Result for an accepted Action.

cases.name: accept-response
cases.description: A Provider responds within a Request's turn sequence.

cases.name: accept-approval
cases.description: A User grants a class Approval.

cases.name: accept-refusal
cases.description: A User refuses an accepted Action.

cases.name: accept-plan
cases.description: A Provider records an advisory Plan for a Request.

cases.name: accept-retraction
cases.description: The admin User retracts an earlier Summary.

cases.name: accept-signed-pinned
cases.description: A key-pinned User authors a validly signed Request.

cases.name: reject-request-wrong-role
cases.description: A Request whose author claims Provider instead of User.

cases.name: reject-unregistered-author
cases.description: A Request from an actor not registered in author_roles.

cases.name: reject-signature-missing
cases.description: A key-pinned actor authors an unsigned record.

cases.name: reject-signature-invalid
cases.description: A key-pinned actor signs with a key that is not pinned.

cases.name: reject-unknown-schema
cases.description: A record whose schema is absent from the rules' schema map.

cases.name: reject-kind-schema-mismatch
cases.description: A Request record carrying the Capability schema id.

cases.name: reject-non-canonical-payload
cases.description: A Request whose data bytes are valid JSON but not the exact JCS form.

cases.name: reject-request-missing
cases.description: A Response referencing a request id that is not in the log.

cases.name: reject-authority-ref-missing
cases.description: An Action that does not name any capability via a Require ref.

cases.name: reject-capability-denied
cases.description: An Action naming a Deny-mode capability.

cases.name: reject-approval-missing
cases.description: An Ask-mode Action with no matching approval.

cases.name: reject-ref-unresolved
cases.description: An Action naming a capability that was retracted before the action.

cases.name: reject-external-receipt-required
cases.description: A Result for an External-mode action that uses the internal Result schema instead of the external-receipt schema.

cases.name: reject-evidence-below-threshold
cases.description: A Summary whose derived evidence is weaker than the per-kind threshold.

cases.name: reject-capability-missing
cases.description: An Action for a class with no matching capability (a capability exists for a different class).

cases.name: reject-capability-expired
cases.description: An Action naming a capability whose expiry time has passed.

cases.name: reject-approval-expired
cases.description: An Ask-mode Action naming a class approval whose expiry time has passed.

cases.name: reject-action-closed
cases.description: A Result whose action id refers to a record that is not an open action.

cases.name: reject-replacement-invalid
cases.description: A Capability carrying a Replace ref to a Request (a different kind).

cases.name: reject-exact-approval-single-use
cases.description: A second Action reusing an exact approval that a first Action already consumed.

cases.name: accept-candidate-root
cases.description: A root Candidate with a reported Git binding.

cases.name: accept-requirement-user-authored
cases.description: The human principal states a requirement for an accepted Request: one Cause to the request, provenance user_authored from a User author.

cases.name: accept-requirement-derived
cases.description: The agent derives a requirement from the request: provenance derived from a Provider author.

cases.name: reject-requirement-provenance-not-a-user
cases.description: Provenance is bound to authorship: a Provider claiming user_authored rejects with AuthorRoleInvalid.

cases.name: reject-requirement-derived-by-user
cases.description: The other direction of the binding: a User writing a derived requirement rejects with AuthorRoleInvalid.

cases.name: reject-requirement-executor-author
cases.description: The role that performs work never states what the work must satisfy: an Executor-authored Requirement rejects with AuthorRoleInvalid.

cases.name: reject-requirement-duplicate-key
cases.description: A second Requirement with a key already held under the same request rejects with RequirementInvalid.

cases.name: accept-requirement-key-reused-after-retraction
cases.description: Amendment is retract-and-record: after the principal retracts a requirement, a corrected one may carry the same key.

cases.name: reject-requirement-empty-key
cases.description: A Requirement needs a handle: an empty key rejects with RequirementInvalid.

cases.name: reject-requirement-no-cause
cases.description: A Requirement belongs to a request: with no Cause ref it rejects with RequirementInvalid.

cases.name: reject-requirement-cause-not-a-request
cases.description: The single Cause must target an accepted Request: a Cause to a Capability rejects with RequirementInvalid.

cases.name: reject-requirement-replace
cases.description: Requirements are never replaced (amendment is retract-and-record): a Replace ref rejects with ReplacementInvalid.

cases.name: accept-candidate-with-artifacts
cases.description: A root Candidate binding two artifacts beyond its source: a registered scheme with a label and an unregistered scheme under the generic digest rule, in (scheme, digest, name) order.

cases.name: reject-candidate-artifact-digest-length
cases.description: A registered scheme fixes its digest length: a git-tree-sha1 digest of 32 bytes rejects with ArtifactRefInvalid.

cases.name: reject-candidate-artifact-digest-uppercase
cases.description: Digests are lowercase hex; an uppercase digit rejects with ArtifactRefInvalid.

cases.name: reject-candidate-artifact-scheme-token
cases.description: A scheme is a lowercase token; an uppercase or slash-bearing scheme rejects with ArtifactRefInvalid.

cases.name: reject-candidate-artifacts-unordered
cases.description: The list is strictly sorted by (scheme, digest, name); two well-formed entries in the wrong order reject with ArtifactRefInvalid.

cases.name: reject-candidate-artifacts-duplicate
cases.description: Deduplicated means strictly increasing: a repeated entry rejects with ArtifactRefInvalid.

cases.name: reject-candidate-artifact-unregistered-too-short
cases.description: An unregistered scheme takes the generic rule: a 16-byte digest is below the 20-byte floor and rejects with ArtifactRefInvalid.

cases.name: accept-result-with-artifacts
cases.description: A Result naming the artifact it produced: the same additive list on the executor's record.

cases.name: reject-result-artifact-odd-hex
cases.description: A Result's artifact digest must be even-length hex; an odd-length digest rejects with ArtifactRefInvalid.

cases.name: accept-evaluation
cases.description: An Evaluation that Uses its accepted candidate.

cases.name: accept-selection
cases.description: A Selection that Requires its winner and Uses its evaluation.

cases.name: reject-author-role-candidate-unregistered
cases.description: A Candidate whose author id is not registered in author_roles.

cases.name: reject-author-role-evaluation-mismatch
cases.description: An Evaluation whose author is registered as System but declares Executor.

cases.name: reject-author-role-selection-executor
cases.description: An Executor-authored Selection: decisions are not for the role that performs work.

cases.name: accept-candidate-continuation
cases.description: A Continuation candidate anchored on a Selection, parent in its selected set.

cases.name: accept-candidate-derivation
cases.description: A Derivation candidate whose Cause targets a prior accepted candidate.

cases.name: accept-selection-none
cases.description: A Selection that considers a candidate but selects none (a prune).

cases.name: accept-selection-reaffirmation
cases.description: A Selection that Replaces a prior Selection under the same objective.

cases.name: reject-candidate-source-binding-manifest-mismatch
cases.description: A Candidate whose manifest_hash is present while binding is reported.

cases.name: reject-candidate-source-binding-tree-length
cases.description: A Candidate declaring sha256 with a 40-hex (sha1-length) tree OID.

cases.name: reject-candidate-root-with-parent
cases.description: A Root candidate naming a parent, which Root forbids.

cases.name: reject-candidate-continuation-parent-not-selected
cases.description: A Continuation whose parent resolves but is not in its anchor's selected set.

cases.name: reject-candidate-derivation-selection-cause
cases.description: A Derivation whose Cause targets a Selection, which derivation forbids.

cases.name: reject-evaluation-payload-ref-wrong-kind
cases.description: An Evaluation whose candidate id resolves to a Request, not a Candidate.

cases.name: reject-evaluation-missing-use
cases.description: An Evaluation that resolves its candidate but does not Use it.

cases.name: reject-selection-considered-empty
cases.description: A Selection with an empty considered list.

cases.name: reject-selection-winner-not-required
cases.description: A Selected winner that is not named by a Require ref.

cases.name: reject-selection-none-with-require
cases.description: A None Selection that still Requires a candidate.

cases.name: reject-selection-requires-evaluation
cases.description: A Selected Selection that Uses no Evaluation (default requires one).

cases.name: reject-selection-used-eval-not-considered
cases.description: A Selection Using an Evaluation whose candidate is absent from considered.

cases.name: reject-selection-rejected-eval-does-not-count
cases.description: A Selection whose only Used Evaluation was itself rejected.

cases.name: reject-selection-max-considered
cases.description: A Selection whose considered list exceeds max_considered.

cases.name: accept-selection-comparative-at-max-considered
cases.description: A comparative Selection at max_considered, one evaluation per candidate.

cases.name: reject-selection-min-binding
cases.description: A Selection whose winner is reported-bound under min_binding = manifest.

cases.name: reject-selection-reaffirm-objective
cases.description: A reaffirming Selection whose objective differs from its Replace target.

cases.name: reject-selection-reaffirm-actor
cases.description: A reaffirming Selection whose author is not in reaffirmation_actors.

cases.name: reject-continuation-compromised-anchor
cases.description: A Continuation of a retracted anchor Selection under reject_compromised_continuation.

cases.name: accept-selection-approved
cases.description: A Selection carrying the approval its subject hash binds.

cases.name: reject-selection-approval-missing
cases.description: A Selection under selection_requires_approval with no approval.

cases.name: reject-selection-approval-wrong-actor
cases.description: A Selection whose bound approval declares a different subject actor.

cases.name: reject-selection-approval-expired
cases.description: A Selection whose bound approval expired at its commit time.

cases.name: reject-selection-approval-consumed
cases.description: A Selection reusing an approval a prior identical Selection consumed.

cases.name: reject-selection-approval-diverted-reaffirmation
cases.description: A reaffirmation Requiring an approval granted for the fresh decision.

cases.name: accept-selection-approved-reaffirmation
cases.description: A reaffirmation carrying the approval its Replace-bound subject binds.
